learning_outcomes.text: Knows the history of electric vehicles.
Knows the features of hybrid vehicles, recognizes engine structures and analyzes the differences.
Knows the general characteristics of electric vehicles.
Recognizes the functions of electronic components used in electric vehicles and analyzes their applications.
Knows and analyzes the battery and cell structures used in electric vehicles.
Knows the structure and operating principles of motors used in electric vehicles, and recognizes their labels.
Analyzes the charging cycles in electric vehicles and recognizes the equipment used.
Analyzes the interaction of electric vehicles with the grid and other energy sources.
Analyzes problems encountered in electric vehicles and their solution methods.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the history and development of electric and hybrid vehicles
Structure of typical electric and hybrid vehicles
Operating principles of motor drivers and controllers
Examination of current electric vehicle examples
Fuel cell hybrid and electric vehicles
Types of electric motors used in vehicle applications
Torque-speed graph of a hybrid vehicle
Modeling the control of electric and hybrid vehicles
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decision in the academic calendar.
